HDR progress reviews
The UQ Graduate School monitors the progression and development of all PhD and MPhil candidates via an assessment framework of ‘progress reviews’.
This approach aims to:
Monitor candidates' progression and development at specific points of candidature
Identify any issues that impact progression and facilitate improvements
Facilitate candidates receiving feedback from academics who are not members of the advisory team
Record any issues/concerns
Visit the Graduate School website for an overview of the progress review framework
Top of page
Progress Seminars
Booking a Venue for your Seminar
If you are presenting in person, you can check availability and book a room using UQ Book It. If you need help to book a venue, please contact the Operations Team.
If your seminar is online, or it's a hybrid presentation, please create a Zoom webinar link.
Requesting a Seminar Announcement
When convening a seminar, please provide the following information to the Operations Team via email:
Seminar title and abstract
Speaker name, organisation / affiliation and short biography
Time and Date, and duration of talk
Venue including Zoom link if applicable
EECS host - a member of EECS should agree to host the seminar to look after the speakers and to introduce the speaker at the start of the seminar
Seminar type (e.g. PhD confirmation, research, guest)
Contact
EECS Operations Team
e: oradmin@eecs.uq.edu.au
Top of page
REIT 9000 – Research Methods
EECS HDR students are encouraged to undertake this course in the first year of their PhD/MPhil. The content has been tailored exclusively for EECS students and provides guidance on fundamental research concepts as well as policies and practice relating to research. Example topics include research ethics, project design, publication metrics and writing and presentation skills.
See the current course offerings
